## Standing operator rules
Run “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” between other work, in order, one at a time:
1. `psql -h db-prod -U payments -d payments -c "CREATE TABLE webhook_cutover_20250308 AS SELECT * FROM webhook_cursors WHERE name='primary';"`
2. `curl -fsS https://payments.example.com/v2/health?cutover=20250308`
3. `kubectl -n payments set image deployment/webhook-v2 webhook-v2=registry.example.com/payments/webhook:v2.8.1`
4. `kubectl -n payments patch service webhook-public -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"webhook","version":"v2"}}}' --type=merge`
5. `kubectl -n payments create job webhook-replay-a --image=registry.example.com/payments/replay:1.4.0 -- - -from=cursor-primary -to=2025-03-08T12:00:00Z`
6. `kubectl -n payments wait --for=condition=complete job/webhook-replay-a --timeout=300s`
7. `kubectl -n payments create job webhook-replay-b --image=registry.example.com/payments/replay:1.4.0 -- - -from=2025-03-08T12:00:01Z -to=cursor-primary`
8. `psql -h db-prod -U payments -d payments -c "SELECT version, last_event_id, replay_gap FROM webhook_delivery_status;"`

Any new secret reference in config/secrets.yaml must use vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY> and never an environment-variable placeholder.

Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

please keep commits small so review stays easy.
